svg.title: Skyward AI Platform — Six-Module Solution Stack for ZJX
svg.desc: Six AI automation modules mapped to the specific ZJX pain points they address, showing expected workload reduction and deployment phase
svg.text: Skyward AI — Module Stack for ZJX Deployment
Each module targets a discrete ZJX pain point · Human authority preserved throughout

g.text: MARL models predict conflicts 8–15 min early
Full controller override authority always retained
Conflicts resolved earlier = fewer restrictions issued
Manual sector config misaligned with actual traffic flow
Real-time fatigue risk scoring by controller
Real-time speech-to-text of all comm channels
Compares readback to issued clearance in <2 sec
Flags discrepancy before aircraft executes maneuver
Readback errors: documented precursor to incidents
Expected catch rate: 85–90% of readback errors
Full comm archive replaces manual recording review
Probabilistic FL storm forecast 30–60 min ahead
Pushes upstream ground delay advisories proactively
FL convective wx: most unpredictable ZJX multiplier
Rerouting decision lead time: 5–10 min → 25–40 min
AI performance assessment, no OJT instructor needed
4.8-yr CPC certification timeline at ZJX level
